title: Close prepared ORM documentation
body:
## Linked issue

n/a — documentation-only project close-out; Linear integration and ticket-prefixed naming were explicitly waived. Feature delivery merged in #30260, #30289 and #30309.

## Summary

Reconcile the prepared ORM documentation with the shipped aggregate surface. All five project acceptance criteria have been verified against the merged implementation and its recorded evidence; no feature work remains in this close-out.

ADR 210 now describes ordinary/grouped aggregate promise results, preparation-time metadata reuse versus fresh execution results, and construction-time ORM nullable comparisons without implying SQL/AST rewrites. Both facade READMEs link to the existing aggregate reference.

## Testing performed

- `pnpm lint:docs` passed (existing missing-Responsibilities warnings).
- Post-rebase local link checks passed: seven link file targets across the three documentation files, plus the prepared-row-descriptions destination heading.
- `pnpm check:upgrade-coverage --mode pr --prev eb6b3d3701c82d1444cbf606ea849916a7e7aba1 --head 9590f82ba5d0255a1d2dbe70b35d609a2acf02b1` passed against committed trees.
- `git diff --check` and base-to-HEAD diff check passed.
- Feature CI and QA are historical evidence from the merged PRs, not freshly run suites. No build or code tests were run for this documentation-only change.

## Skill update

No API changes or new skill instructions.

## Checklist

- [x] All commits carry DCO sign-off.
- [x] CONTRIBUTING.md read; one logical documentation close-out.
- [x] Tests: n/a — documentation-only, no behavioral delta.
- [ ] Ticket-prefixed title: explicitly waived for this project's lifecycle.
- [x] Skill update disposition recorded above.

## Notes for the reviewer

Exactly four files change: three documentation files and `upgrade-instructions/pending/orm-prepared-docs-closeout/extension/instructions.md`, containing only a `changes: []` declaration. This PR-owned no-op declaration satisfies upgrade coverage for the extension README changes relative to the actual target base; inherited declarations do not count. No retro notes are added. No implementation fixes, new architectural decisions or tracked artifact deletions are included. Local evidence was archived separately outside the checkout with user authorization: all 408 files, including five QA databases, were verified by exact inventory, size, SHA-256 and modes before removing the original directory. No local QA data entered Git. Canonical close-out trace emission was attempted but blocked by the installed emitter's missing `arktype` dependency; the failure record and existing trace are preserved in the archive.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **New Features**
  - Prepared ORM queries now support aggregate operations for both ungrouped and grouped collections.
  - Aggregate results are returned in decoded, typed formats, including appropriate results for empty collections.
  - Prepared grouped queries support aggregate filtering and preserve model mapping.

- **Documentation**
  - Updated PostgreSQL and SQLite documentation with prepared ORM aggregate examples, result types, grouping, filtering, supported predicates, includes, and pagination guidance.
